superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.s1.3: First I've seen in a while.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.s2.1: I'm stuck. Not quite alive... or dead.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.s2.2: Not enough of me to revive either.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.s3.1: Take my bag. Make a weapon.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.how.1: Make a handle. Use the wood.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.how.2: Add a guard. Use the stone.
superior_tutorial.decaying_corpse.how.3: Finish the blade. Use the alloy.
superior_tutorial.choice.how_forge: How do I forge a weapon?
superior_tutorial.choice.where_forge: Where do I forge a weapon?
superior_tutorial.choice.no_time: I don't have time for this.
superior_tutorial.choice.another_way: There has to be another way.
commands.superior_tutorial.placed: Placed the tutorial cove at %s %s %s. Players who haven't started will begin in its cave.
commands.superior_tutorial.no_cove: This world has no tutorial cove. Stand where the sinkhole should open and use /superior_tutorial place_cove.
commands.superior_tutorial.overworld_onl: The tutorial cove can only go in the Overworld.
commands.superior_tutorial.too_low: Too low: the cove reaches 45 blocks below where you stand.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.1: I was unloading the boat this morning. One of the crates went over.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.2: I stood on the dock, dumbfounded, as it sank like a stone.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.3: I may be an aquatic warrior, but...
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.5: Fish it out for me, and I'll see you right.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.get: More than a wet crate's worth. You'll see.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.where.1: Off the end of the dock. Look down.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.where.2: It's a crate. It won't be hiding.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.yes: Good. Don't drown. I'm not fishing you out as well.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.deal.no: It's not going anywhere. Neither am I.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.who.3: Acclaimed monster hunter and exotic merchant.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.who.4: No aquatic critter stands a chance against my rod and net!
superior_tutorial.choice.fisherman.way_o: How do I get out of here?
superior_tutorial.fisherman.out.1: Up. When you hit rock bottom, it's the only way there is.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.out.2: But up isn't what you want. You reek of aspirations.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.out.3: I might know a thing or two about that.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.out.4: Help me with something first, and I'll make it worth your while.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.bye: Mind the third board. It's soft.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.meet.2: Now listen up. Here's the thing.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.meet.3: I paid good money to have this cave cleared. And you are here, nonetheless.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.meet.4: I'll be the first to tell you, if you want something done properly, you gotta do it yourself!
superior_tutorial.choice.fisherman.corps: There was a corpse down there.
So you're telling me I hired three guards to clear a tiny cave, and not only did they miss one person, but two?
superior_tutorial.fisherman.corpse.slain: I might as well pay you to clear caves instead.
Three guards, and they missed an actual person AND an undead?
By the Mire, I'll find those guards...
superior_tutorial.fisherman.again.2: Thought any more about my crate?
superior_tutorial.fisherman.wait.where: End of the dock. Down. Wet. You'll find it.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.wait.lost.2: ...It'll wash back to the same spot. Things do, here.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.wait.later: No hurry. Fish don't rush. Neither do I.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.early.2: Well. Saves us both some talking!
superior_tutorial.fisherman.handin.1: That's the one. I know that smell.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.paid.2: This map will take you to my hometown. They'll sell you more than I can.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.paid.3: And this. Bits and pieces for the road. Don't let the crab out near my dock.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.paid.4: Tell them Haskel sent you. Or don't. They'll charge you the same!
superior_tutorial.fisherman.after: Come back after the next flood. There's always something worth selling.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.hit.1: Haskel: Easy. I bruise like a pear.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.hit.2: Haskel: That's no way to haggle.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.crate.taken: You pull the crate free of the silt.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.crate.hooked: Your line snags on something heavy. A crate comes up.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.crate.done: Just silt and an old rope now.
superior_tutorial.fisherman.no_village: Haskel: Here, take the sack. Don't die!
